CustomField.description: Is there an Annual Accrual Limit? (Maximum number of hours accrued within a Calendar Year (1/1 – 12/31)/ Anniversary Year/ Client’s Fiscal Year year not including carryover). Once this limit is hit, they do not accrue any more hours during the plan year.
